notes.title: Major Update v 0.831
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

I noticed that many players don't understand how to play and what to do in the game. So the Tutorial and Tips system has been revised and significantly improved. Also UI and game balance has been changed to make the game process more intuitive.  

I hope these fixes improve your gameplay experience and thanks for your continued support.

Don't forget to install the updated free demo and give me your feedback in Steam Community Discussions.
